hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eq '"stop_hook_active" *: *true'; then exit 0; fi; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exit 0; fi; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 1>&2; code=$?; if [ $code -eq 0 ] || [ $code -eq 5 ]; then exit 0; fi; echo 'pytest is failing. Keep working until all tests pass. Do not edit any test file.' 1>&2; exit 2
